svg.aria-label: Cross-sections of a wall with room behind its beads and of a thin rib, each with the outline-shrink and the toolpath-shift method of the precise outer wall: the thick wall comes out the same, the rib is dropped by outline shrink and printed at true thickness by toolpath shift.
svg.title: Precise outer wall: outline shrink pays for the gap behind the outer wall with model thickness, toolpath shift pays with the room behind the walls.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: precise_outer_wall_method: outline_shrink | toolpath_shift g = (outer wall width - spacing) / 2
